title: Financial ABM: an auditable multi-agent artificial market for ESG disclosure and greenwashing policy experiments
description: Code, configurations, pre-registrations and evidence for the working paper Information versus Enforcement against Greenwashing: Pre-Registered Experiments in a Multi-Agent Artificial Market (Ellis Lin, 2026). An agent-based artificial financial market in which profit-maximising and impact investors evolve by imitation, firms choose between real improvement, greenwashing and maintenance, and a regulator sets transparency, audits and fines. The archive contains the pre-registered stage F experiment (59 scenarios x 30 paired seeds), its exploratory supplements, the pre-registered targeted-audit experiment (15 scenarios x 30 seeds) and the paper source. Vendor data without a redistribution licence are not included; collection scripts and hash manifests are. Results are conditional on the model.
